title: Entity Brief Generator
short: Turn audit findings into a brief a writer can act on: canonical name, entities to add, entities to demote, and the placements that matter.
inputs: One page's audit row, plus the current page content
outputs: A structured brief you can print or export
how: Paste your Anthropic key and fill in the audit row for one page.
Add the missing entities from your gap matrix and the canonical name.
Paste the current content — the brief is an edit instruction, not a commission.
Read the brief, and check every factual claim it moved or kept.
Export it. It goes to a writer, not to a publish button.
note: Never auto-publish a rewrite of a page that carries factual claims or currently ranks well.
